Self.Wiki: This map object represents a part within the map.

InstanceID.Wiki: Determines the instance of this map object. Should be unique between map objects of the same model name.

ModelName.Wiki: The model of the map object, corresponding to an entry in the ModelParam.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the map object, in degrees.

Scale.Wiki: Scale of the map object, only meaningful for map pieces and objects.

MapStudioLayer.Wiki: The map layer this map object is placed on. Appears unused by the game; Smithbox uses it to select objects by layer.

SibPath.Wiki: A path to a .sib file, presumed to be some kind of editor placeholder.

EntityData.Wiki: Entity IDs, placement filters and draw settings.

DisplayGroupData.Wiki: The display groups a collision shows while it is stood on.

SceneGparamData.Wiki: Scene gparam settings of a collision.

Unk88Data.Wiki: Unused in the game files (all zero).

TileData.Wiki: Where a copied map object comes from: the distant-view tiles copy the detailed tiles' objects.

UnkA0Data.Wiki: Unused in the game files (all zero).

UnkA8Data.Wiki: The ScenarioPlacementParam key that changes this map object by scenario progress.

DisplayData.Wiki: Display and draw groups, with an alternate set of each that the game can swap or merge in on load. Same layout as Elden Ring.

DisplayGroups.Wiki: The groups this map object shows; for a collision, the groups shown while the player stands on it.

AltDisplayGroups.Wiki: Display groups that replace, or are merged into, the display groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDisplayGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the display group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate display groups.

DrawGroups.Wiki: Controls when the map object is visible: it is drawn while any of these groups is shown.

AltDrawGroups.Wiki: Draw groups merged into the draw groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDrawGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the draw group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate draw groups.

NoAltGroupMerge.Wiki: If ON, the alternate groups are never merged in, only swapped in whole.

UseAltGroups.Wiki: Enables the alternate groups. Depending on a game state, the display groups are replaced by the alternate display groups, or both sets are merged in through their masks.

Condition.Wiki: The number of one more display group shown together with Display Groups while standing on the collision. -1 for none. Collisions and connect collisions use 1 to 80 in the game files.

DispGroups.Wiki: Display groups shown while standing on this collision (for a connect collision, in the map it loads).

Unk3C.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 on almost every map object; a few assets use 2 to 900.

Unk3E.Wiki: Read by the game; a rendering flag in Elden Ring. ON for about 1,700 assets and most map pieces.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the map object in event scripts.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: A entity group ID this map object belongs to

Variation.Wiki: -1 places the map object every session. Otherwise it is placed only when this equals the map's variation for the session: the expedition target in the boss arena maps (m16, m18, m19), or the variation the map pattern picked for a small-base map (LotResultSmallBaseAndSpot Variation ID). In m16_00 and m19_00 a session flag adds 10 to the variation.

VariationAlsoPlus10.Wiki: Assets in m16_00 and m19_00 only: if ON, the asset is also placed when the map's variation is Variation + 10, so one asset serves both versions of the arena.

RandomAppearParamID.Wiki: 0 for none. One slot from 0 to 99 is drawn each session; the map object is placed only if this RandomAppearParam row has that slot. Rows come in pairs that split the slots, so exactly one of two map objects on a pair appears. A row with no slots means the object never appears.

isUsePartsDrawParamID.Wiki: If ON, enables use of Parts Draw Param ID. If OFF, the asset param is used instead.

PartsDrawParamID.Wiki: The PartsDrawParam row used when Use Parts Draw Param ID is on. Each draw flag below falls back to this row when its override is off.

OverridePointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Point Light Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isPointLightShadowSrc.

IsPointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts point light shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Sun Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isDirLightShadowSrc (on by default).

IsDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts the sun's (directional light's) shadow. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowDest.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Destination is used instead of the draw param's isShadowDst (on by default).

IsShadowDest.Wiki: Whether shadows fall on the map object. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowOnly.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Only is used instead of the draw param's isShadowOnly.

IsShadowOnly.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn into shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawByReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawByReflectCam.

DrawByReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Override: Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawOnlyReflectCam.

DrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
DrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

DisableRTAO.Wiki: If ON, disables ray-traced ambient occlusion for the map object.

ScenarioPlacementKey0.Wiki: With Key 2 and Step, picks the ScenarioPlacementParam row that changes this map object by scenario progress: the row whose two keys and step match. For enemies the row's Chara Init Param ID is used. -1 in any of the three means none.

ScenarioPlacementKey1.Wiki: Second key of the ScenarioPlacementParam row (see Scenario Placement Key 1). -1 for none.

ScenarioPlacementStep.Wiki: Step of the ScenarioPlacementParam row (see Scenario Placement Key 1), 1 to 5 in the game files. -1 for none.

LightID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from LightSet ParamEditor to use.

FogID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from FogParamEditor to use.

TransitionTime.Wiki: Amount of time it takes for GParam to transition (in seconds). -1 = Some default time.

Unk18.Wiki: The scene gparam sub ID (the 0N00 of mAA_BB_0N00) the collision picks, as in Elden Ring. -1 for none. Smithbox's lighting preview uses it; the game was not seen reading it.

Unk1D.Wiki: Read by the game for collisions. -1 or 0 in the game files.

Unk20.Wiki: A gparam sub ID read by the game for collisions. -1 for none; a few collisions use 0 or 30.

GrassParamIds.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

Unk00.Wiki: Read by the game for assets and map pieces; sets rendering flags in Elden Ring (1 or 2). 0 in the game files except one asset (2).

MapID.Wiki: The map this map object was copied from, as four numbers (mAA_BB_CC_DD). The distant-view tiles copy the detailed tiles' objects. -1 for the map's own objects.

NamePrefixLength.Wiki: How many characters at the start of the name the game skips to get the object's own name: 13 for copies named mAA_BB_CC_DD- followed by the original name, else 0.

Unk0C.Wiki: Read by the game for assets. In Elden Ring, an index into the collisions of the source map; -1 for none. 0 to 8 or -1 on copied assets.

SourceInstanceID.Wiki: The instance ID the game uses for this map object instead of Instance ID. -1 uses Instance ID. Copies carry the original object's instance ID here.
